styles.a: Dark gritty painterly medieval fantasy game art, hand-painted oil texture, rich muted earthy colours with warm firelight glow, dramatic cinematic light, suitable for children aged 8 to 12, no writing, no letters, no numbers anywhere.

pictures.name: town
pictures.prompt: A bird's-eye three-quarter view illustrated map of a small walled medieval clan town in a misty mountain valley at dusk, seen from high above at an angle like a game world map, every place small, clear and separate with open ground and dirt paths between them. Left: rocky hills with a dark mine entrance glowing orange, mine carts and wooden supports. Lower left: a busy market square with colourful striped tents and stalls and lanterns. Centre: a big wooden great hall with a carved roof and clan banners, the clan's home, inside a wooden palisade with a gate. Lower centre: a fenced training yard with straw dummies, weapon racks and an archery target. Right: a small stone church with a tall spire and glowing windows. Lower right: a cosy tavern with a big quest notice board covered in pinned papers outside. Upper right: a tall stone hall of heroes with golden banners and statues. Near the gate: a herald's watchtower with a bell. Top: dark jagged mountains with a giant shadowy cave lair under storm clouds. Landscape, wide.
